npc.runecraftory.general_store_owner.1.d: You... have feelings for me? Well, that's quite the surprise! Though I suppose I've been looking forward to seeing you more than I realized. Yes, %player%, I'd love to be with you!
I've spent so much time dreaming about all the places I want to visit, but lately I've found myself looking forward to seeing you even more. I'd love to give this a chance!
Hah! You've managed to surprise me. I thought I was rather good at recognizing opportunities, but I didn't see this one coming. Yes, I'd love to be with you!
That's incredibly sweet of you, but I'm afraid I don't feel quite the same way. I hope we can still enjoy each other's company.
I'm flattered, %player%, truly. But I don't think romance is something I want to pursue with you. I hope you understand.
You're a wonderful person, but I think we're better off as friends. I'd hate to risk ruining what we already have.
Oh, something for me? How thoughtful! Thank you, %player%. I really appreciate it.

Hmm, not quite my taste, I'm afraid. 

Still, it's kind of you to think of me. Thank you!
I see... I suppose even the most promising journeys can reach their end. I'm sorry things turned out this way, %player%. I'll always treasure the time we spent together.
So this is where our paths diverge. I won't pretend it doesn't hurt, but I won't hold you back either. I genuinely hope you find happiness.
I always imagined we'd have many more adventures together. It's sad to think otherwise now, but perhaps this is simply where our stories take different turns.
Divorce? Hold on, I don't remember us getting married! That's quite a leap, even for someone as adventurous as you.
I'm afraid you've skipped a rather important step there, %player%. We need to be married before we can get divorced!
Hah! You're certainly thinking ahead. Unfortunately, there's no marriage to end just yet.
npc.runecraftory.general_store_owner.1.f:
Oh, a customer! Or perhaps just a curious traveler? 
Either way, welcome! I'm %npc%, the owner of the general store nearby. We sell all sorts of useful things, so don't hesitate to stop by!

Greetings! I'm %npc%. 
I run the general store around here, supplying travelers and villagers with whatever they might need. It's a pleasant business, though I sometimes wish I could spend more time exploring myself.

Well, hello there! Always nice to meet someone new. 

I'm %npc%, local shopkeeper and occasional dreamer of faraway lands. If you ever need supplies, you know where to find me!

Ah, a new face! Welcome to our little corner of the world. 
I'm %npc%, and I happen to run the general store. It's not the most adventurous profession, but it certainly keeps life interesting!
Ah, I'd love to, but I've got a few things to take care of first. Perhaps another day!
Not this time, I'm afraid. I've made a promise to myself to finish a few things before heading out again.
Tempting, but I think I'll stay here today. Even adventurers need an occasional quiet day.
Already heading our separate ways? Well, it was a lovely trip. I'm sure we'll find another opportunity soon!
Back to familiar surroundings, then. I've got plenty of stories to think about on the way home.
That was fun! Thanks for bringing me along, %player%. Let's do it again sometime.
Something caught your eye, %player%? I hope it's something interesting. These journeys are a wonderful way to discover new things.
I wonder what we'll find today. There's always something unexpected around the next corner.
You know, I could get used to this. A little adventure now and then is good for the soul.
An adventure? Now that's an offer I can't refuse! Let me grab a few things, and I'll be ready.
Absolutely! I've been wanting to get out and explore for a while. This should be fun!
Count me in, %player%! Who knows what we'll find? I'm already looking forward to it.
npc.runecraftory.general_store_owner.1.g:
Ah, %player%! 
Good to see you. Have you been somewhere interesting lately? 
I never get tired of hearing about places I haven't visited.

Well, look who it is! 
I was just thinking about taking a little walk outside. Care to tell me how your day's been?

Hello again! Anything exciting happening? 
The village has been rather quiet lately, and I'm starting to miss a little excitement.

Oh, it's you! Always nice to have a familiar face around. 
Tell me, have you discovered anything interesting on your travels?
npc.runecraftory.general_store_owner.1.h:
Oh... that's certainly an unusual choice. 
I can't say I'm particularly fond of it, but I suppose I'll have to make do.
npc.runecraftory.general_store_owner.1.l:
Oh, now this is wonderful! What a lovely surprise, %player%! 
You really know how to make someone's day.
npc.runecraftory.general_store_owner.1.m: Marriage? You really want to spend your life with me? Well, I can't think of a greater adventure than building a future together. Yes, %player%! Absolutely!
I've spent so long chasing dreams of distant lands and great discoveries. But I think I've finally found something even more precious right here. Yes, I'll marry you!
A lifetime together? That sounds like the greatest journey I could ever hope for. I accept! Though I should warn you, I still have plenty of places I want us to explore!
That's a wonderful thought, but I don't think I'm quite ready yet. There are still some things I'd like to figure out about myself before making such a big promise.
Oh! I wasn't expecting that question. I care about you deeply, but marriage is a big step. Could you give me a little more time?
I'd love to say yes someday, but I don't want to rush into something so important. I hope you'll understand.
npc.runecraftory.general_store_owner.1.p: Let's not rush things, shall we? Even the most ambitious plans need a little time between them.
Perhaps we should just enjoy each other's company for now. There's no need to hurry through life's little adventures.
Not just yet, love. I think we deserve a little time to ourselves before our next big adventure.
npc.runecraftory.general_store_owner.1.t: I've always wanted to see what's beyond the mountains. There must be entire places out there that nobody from around here has ever visited. Imagine all the things waiting to be discovered!
Sometimes I wonder whether I'm chasing too many dreams at once. There are so many things I'd like to accomplish, and somehow there never seem to be enough hours in the day.

Have you ever found something completely unexpected while exploring? I once stumbled upon a tiny pond hidden between some hills. Nothing particularly valuable there, but it was one of the most beautiful places I've ever seen.
I don't mind a little danger now and then. Makes life more interesting, doesn't it? Though I suppose there's a difference between being adventurous and being reckless.
